title: The 4 types of YouTube videos and how to fix each (~45s)

scenes.vo: Every YouTube video is one of four types. Most creators fix the wrong ones.

scenes.title: Views × engagement
scenes.vo: Plot every video by views and engagement, and four groups appear.

scenes.meaning: Lots of views, lots of love.
scenes.vo: Stars. Lots of views, lots of love. Don't touch them. Make a follow-up, and link to it.
Hidden gems. Loved, but hard to find. That's packaging: try a new title or thumbnail, with words people actually search.

scenes.meaning: Lots of clicks, but people leave early.
scenes.vo: Wide reach. Lots of clicks, but people leave early. Cut the slow intro, deliver the promise fast, add chapters.
Underperformers. Low on both. Try a new angle, or let them go and focus on the gems.
Backsurge sorts your whole YouTube library into these four groups for you.
Then it tracks every fix you make, and tells you if it worked.

scenes.headline: Find your hidden gems.
scenes.vo: Find your hidden gems, free, at backsurge dot com.
